items.text: paise kat gaye
nahi kiya maine
help chahiye
theek hai
jaldi karo
samajh gaya

items.context: Kya main aapki madad kar sakta hoon?
items.text: ha ji

items.context: Aap kaunse transaction ki baat kar rahe hain?
items.text: theek hai

items.context: Kya aapke account se unauthorized transaction hua hai?
items.text: ji han
Mera account se kal raat ko paise kat gaye bina meri ijazat ke
Maine bank statement check kiya par mujhe koi transaction nahi karna yaad
Kya aap mere account ka har transaction detail check kar sakte hain please
Mujhe lagta hai koi mere account ka misuse kar raha hai paise nikalne ke liye
Kya aap pata kar sakte hain yeh transaction kis ladke ne kiya tha
Meri salary account se bina bataye 5000 rupaye transfer ho gaye hain mujhe problem ho rahi hai
Mein nahi chahta ke koi bhi mera paisa bina bataye nikaal sake mujhe iska solution batao

items.context: Kya aap transaction ki date ya amount bata sakte hain?
items.text: Haan please wo transaction 15 march ka tha jisme mujhe paise nahi diye gaye

items.context: Kya aap confirm kar sakte hain ke yeh transaction aapne nahi kiya?
items.text: Maine apne account se 2000 rupaye ka transfer nahi kiya hai ye to gaib ho gaya paisa

items.context: Kya aap please apna account number batayenge?
items.text: Mujhe aapke account number par unauthorized debit notice mila hai ab main kya karun

items.context: Kya aap online banking ka istemal karte hain?
items.text: Maine apne paise ko track karne ki koshish ki par pata nahi chala kisne kiya transfer

items.context: Kya aapke pass transaction ka reference number hai?
items.text: Mujhe pata chala ki kal raat ko 10000 ka unauthorized fund transfer hua hai merese bina pooche
Maine notice kiya ki mera account se 12000 rupaye bina mere pata ke kisi ne transfer kar diye hain kal raat ko
Mujhe apne bank statement me abnormal transaction mila hai jise maine nahi kiya aur ye mujhe bahut pareshaan kar raha hai
Kya aap mujhe bata sakte hain ki mujhe apne account ko safe kaise rakhna chahiye aur unauthorized debit kaise rokna chahiye

items.context: Kya aap error transaction ke bare me kuch batayenge?
items.text: Maine dekha ki aapke system me mera account se unauthorized transaction dikha hua hai aur main chahta hoon uska turant solution mile

items.context: Kya aapke account me pehle bhi aisa unauthorized debit hua hai?
items.text: Bank mein jab se mera account khola hai mujhe aise unauthorized debit ka experience hua hai ab mujhe help chahiye solution milega kya?

items.context: Kya aap hume batayenge ki aapko kaunse steps lene honge is problem ko solve karne ke liye?
items.text: Main chahata hoon ki mera account jaldi se secure ho jaye aur jo paise unauthorized kaat gaye hain wo mujhe wapas mil jaye

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: unauthorised_debit - reports a transaction they did not make
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
